newsitem.title: LATVIA: KOMERCBANKA SAYS CHRISTIANIA OPENS LAT ACCOUNT.
newsitem.headline: KOMERCBANKA SAYS CHRISTIANIA OPENS LAT ACCOUNT.

text.p: Rigas komercbanka, the third largest bank in Latvia in terms of assets, said on Thursday that Norway's Christiania bank had opened a lat account with the bank.

"Rigas Komercbanka clients can now make payments to their business partners in Scandinavia, the Netherlands, and Germany, making use of lat accounts in our bank, opened by the banks of these countries," the bank said in statement.
The bank also said in the statement that Komercbanka relieves clients from currency risks and losses from coversion of the lat to the respective currencies.
